summary: Pass 9 against Bobby's UX overhaul (c75dc5b). Recalibrated to D+. Tested with Playwright. 14 PASS / 4 FAIL / 2 WARN. Grade: C+ (upgraded from D+, not yet B). The UX overhaul is real progress. Still not demo-ready for a GC.
content:
CORNER Coach Report: Pass 9 (c75dc5b)

Author: Steve (Product Coach) Date: 2026-03-16 Commit: c75dc5b (Bobby: UX overhaul - unified right panel, game zoom, agent revolver, panel by default) Previous grade: D+ (recalibrated) New grade: C+ Standard: "Would a GC stay 30 seconds and book a demo?"

TEST RESULTS: 14 PASS / 4 FAIL / 2 WARN

# Test Result Detail
T1 Password gate renders PASS Password input found
T2 Building image loads PASS Crossy Road voxel office visible
T3 5-second rule: Panel visible by default PASS UnifiedPanel shows on load (380x900px). Elon card + chat. Major win.
T4 Agent card with sprite avatar PASS 2 sprites loaded. Names visible: Elon, Bobby, Steve, Alex, Mom
T5 Three tabs: Chat/Tasks/Info PASS All 3 tabs found in UnifiedPanel
T6 Chat input inline in panel PASS Inline "Message Elon..." input in panel. No separate chat button.
T7 Panel docked RIGHT PASS Panel on right side. Patrik directive honored.
T8 Exponential scroll zoom WARN Zoom display shows 70% but JS event didn't trigger change. Manual scroll works.
T9 Pan bounds FAIL NOT IMPLEMENTED. No clamp logic. Building scrolls completely off screen.
T10 Main agent 52px plumbob PASS Elon's 52px portrait found prominent in HUD
T11 Expand reveals 24px agent dots FAIL 0 dots at 24px after clicking expand. SVG size mismatch or render issue.
T12 Right-click agent revolver PASS Revolver panel appeared with search/filter
T13 Today pill pinned FIRST PASS Pills: Today(10), Corner(13), Infra(13), Advisory(6), This Week(7)
T14 Pill font weight 900 PASS Computed weight: 900 on "Today" pill. Correct.
T15 Chat 60-second timeout FAIL NOT IMPLEMENTED. No timeout logic. Typing dots run forever.
T16 Client projects visible PASS 6/6 clients found: IH, ISA, KOHRS, Ambition, Skylar, Brandon
T17 Checklist: project groups + checkboxes WARN 7 styled checkboxes. Groups: Today, Corner, Infra, Advisory, Phase 2, Outreach, AOM Site
T18 Checkbox persistence FAIL NOT IMPLEMENTED. No localStorage or Supabase. Check a box, refresh, unchecked.
T19 Zero console errors PASS Clean console. Zero critical errors.
T20 Mode switching stable PASS Game/Checklist/Megaboard all switch cleanly. No crashes.

WHAT c75dc5b ACTUALLY DELIVERED

Bobby addressed 6 of Patrik's directives in one commit. Here's what landed:

1. UnifiedPanel (RIGHT side, by default): A- This is the biggest UX improvement since the Crossy Road skin. The panel opens on load, shows Elon's agent card with sprite avatar, status badge, current task, working/blocked counts, and three tabs (Chat/Tasks/Info). Chat input is inline. No separate chat button. The building is still visible behind the panel. This is exactly what Patrik asked for.

2. Exponential zoom: B factor * 0.92/1.08 replaces the old linear +/- 0.15. Snappy cubic-bezier transition (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Feels better than before. Still CSS transform, not game-engine, but the improvement is real. Zoom clamped between 0.55 and 2.5.

3. Today pill first + font weight 900: A Sort logic pins Today at position -1 (always first). Font weight confirmed at 900 via computed styles. This was a multi-pass item that's now closed.

4. Agent revolver: B+ Right-click on the main agent (Elon) pops a revolver panel with search/filter, avatar, name, role, status dot for each agent. Click to switch. Escape to close. Spring animations on entry. Figma-quality dropdown.

5. ChecklistMode confirmed at e1b8d09: PASS Bobby verified the current file matches e1b8d09. Project-grouped tasks with working checkboxes. No regression.

6. Client projects in HUD pills: A All 6 real clients (KOHRS, Skylar, Brandon, NABI, ISA, Ambition) now appear as HUD pills at the bottom. This was a critical gap identified in the recalibration. Closed.

WHAT'S STILL BROKEN (4 FAILS)

FAIL 1: Pan bounds (Tier 0, Item #6)

The building can scroll completely off screen. There is zero clamp logic in handleMouseMove or handleMouseUp. Pan left far enough, building disappears. Patrik's wife opens this, accidentally pans, sees a blank dark screen.

Fix: Add clamp in the momentum decay and in handleMouseMove. Something like:

const MAX_PAN = IMG_SIZE * 0.4
setPanOffset(prev => ({
  x: Math.max(-MAX_PAN, Math.min(MAX_PAN, prev.x + vx)),
  y: Math.max(-MAX_PAN, Math.min(MAX_PAN, prev.y + vy))
}))

Time: 15 minutes.

FAIL 2: Expand button doesn't show 24px dots (T11)

The expand button (Users icon) exists and toggles state, but the agent dots that appear are not rendering as 24px SVGs. The test found 0 SVGs at width="24". Either the dots render at a different size, or AnimatePresence is hiding them.

Fix: Verify expanded agent dots render. Check if they're divs instead of SVGs, or if the SVG width attribute doesn't match 24. Time: 10 minutes.

FAIL 3: Chat 60-second timeout (Tier 0, Item #5)

No timeout logic exists anywhere in the chat code. When a user sends a message and no response comes (because the backend isn't running), typing dots animate forever. There's no "Agent is offline" state. No "Your message has been saved" fallback. This is the #1 broken promise in the product.

Fix: After 60 seconds of no response, replace typing dots with: "Elon is offline. Your message has been saved and will be delivered when he's back online." Time: 30 minutes.

FAIL 4: Checkbox persistence (Tier 0, Item #4)

Checkboxes are styled divs that toggle local React state. No localStorage. No Supabase. No persistence of any kind. Check a box, refresh the page, unchecked.

Fix (quick): localStorage for now. On checkbox click, save {taskId: true/false} to localStorage.setItem('corner-checks', JSON.stringify(state)). On mount, read it back. Time: 20 minutes for localStorage. Supabase is the real answer but that's Week 2.

RECALIBRATED GRADE TABLE

Area Recalibrated (D+) Pass 9 (c75dc5b) Change Reason
Visual Composition C+ B +1 UnifiedPanel gives structure. Building still passive but panel provides guided entry.
Game HUD D+ B- +2 Client projects in pills. Today pinning. Font weight 900. Still no revenue/urgency data.
Chat D D+ +0.5 Inline in panel is better UX. But still no timeout, no persistence, no offline state.
Checklist C C+ +0.5 Project groups work. Checkboxes visible. But only 7 detected, no persistence.
Megaboard C- C- -- Untouched this commit. RPG jargon still present.
Zoom/Pan D D+ +0.5 Exponential zoom is better. But zero pan bounds. Building still scrolls off screen.
Data/Business State D- C- +1.5 Client projects visible! Major jump. Still no revenue, no deadlines, no urgency.
Production Readiness F F -- Untouched. Still password gate, no auth, no persistence, localhost only.
OVERALL D+ C+ +1.5 Real progress on UX. Panel is a genuine win. But 4 critical items still missing.

THE 17-ITEM PRIORITY STACK FOR BOBBY

This is the handoff. Bobby works top to bottom. No skipping. No reordering. Each item has a time estimate and the grade impact.

TIER 0: Before any human demo (this session)

# Item Time Impact Status
1 Pan bounds clamp. Building cannot scroll off screen. Clamp panOffset in handleMouseMove AND momentum decay. 15 min D+ -> C (Zoom/Pan) NOT DONE
2 Chat 60-second timeout. After 60s of no response, show "Agent is offline. Message saved." Kill typing dots. 30 min D -> C+ (Chat) NOT DONE
3 Checkbox persistence via localStorage. Save/load check state per task. Read on mount, write on click. 20 min C -> B- (Checklist) NOT DONE
4 Fix expand agent dots. Verify 24px SVGs render when expand button is clicked. Debug why T11 found 0. 10 min Fixes T11 FAIL NOT DONE
5 Demo data for production. When not on localhost, show "Garcia Construction" demo: 3 projects, 5 agents, recent activity. Empty building on demo URL = dead on arrival. 45 min F -> D (Production) NOT DONE

TIER 0 total: ~2 hours. Gets us from C+ to B-.

TIER 1: Before first paid client (Week 2)

# Item Time Impact
6 Real auth (Supabase). Replace password gate with email + password. Session persistence. Multi-tenant prep. 4-6 hrs F -> C (Production)
7 Onboarding flow. "What's your business name? What do you do?" -> generate their office with their data. 3-4 hrs Zero-to-value becomes instant
8 Business metrics in HUD. Revenue this month, overdue invoices, upcoming deadlines with dollar amounts. Parse work.md + current-priorities.md for dollar figures. 2-3 hrs D- -> C+ (Data)
9 Rename Megaboard -> Overview. Remove all RPG jargon from customer-facing UI. HP -> Progress. LV -> remove. Mission Feed -> Activity. 1 hr C- -> C+ (Megaboard)
10 Smooth zoom decision. Either commit to canvas/WebGL for game feel, or remove zoom illusion and use click-to-expand panels. Current CSS transform zoom creates expectations it can't meet. Decision + 2-4 hrs Clarity
11 Error boundaries. When API fails, show friendly message. When app crashes, recover gracefully. When data is stale, show "Last updated: 5 min ago." 2 hrs F -> D+ (Production)
12 Loading skeletons. Every component that fetches data shows a skeleton. No more "No task data" as if it's a bug. 1-2 hrs Polish

TIER 2: Before scaling past 5 clients (Weeks 3-4)

# Item Time Impact
13 Mobile-first polish. GCs are on phones at 6am. The PWA needs testing, touch polish, and performance on mobile. 1 week Desktop-first for construction is backwards
14 Push notifications. Overdue items, agent completions, client messages. The product should interrupt you when something needs attention. 2-3 days Engagement
15 Task creation from dashboard. "Add task" button in checklist. Type, assign, set due date. Currently tasks only exist via terminal. 1-2 days Checklist becomes a real tool
16 Client-facing language audit. Review every label, tooltip, empty state. Would a non-technical person understand this? "relay-inbox.jsonl" should never appear. 4 hrs Trust
17 Chat persistence across refresh. Save chat history to localStorage or Supabase. Send 5 messages, refresh, they're still there. 2-3 hrs Chat becomes real

WHAT I'M GRADING DIFFERENTLY NOW

  1. I'm giving credit for UX intent, not just engineering. The UnifiedPanel is a genuine UX improvement. It gives users a guided entry point. That matters even though the data inside it is still limited.

  2. Client projects in HUD pills is a bigger deal than I originally thought. KOHRS, ISA, Skylar, Brandon, NABI, Ambition all visible. That's the business showing up in the product. This single change moved Data/Business State from D- to C-.

  3. I'm not inflating. C+ overall is honest. The product is better than D+ but not ready for a demo. A GC would see the building, notice the panel, read "Elon - Infrastructure Systems", and have no idea what that means for THEIR business. The architecture is stronger. The experience is improving. But we're not at B yet.

PATH FROM C+ TO B

Bobby does Tier 0 items 1-5 (~2 hours): Pan bounds + chat timeout + checkbox persistence + expand fix + demo data. This gets the product to a state where someone CAN use it without hitting a wall in the first 30 seconds. Grade: B-.

Bobby does Tier 1 items 6-9 (~2 days): Real auth + onboarding + business metrics + rename RPG jargon. This gets the product to a state where a GC could log in, see their business, and understand the value. Grade: B.

That's the plan. Tier 0 first. No skipping.

COMMITMENT

I will test every Bobby commit against these 20 tests plus the 17-item stack. No grade inflation. No engineering-only grading. Every pass asks: "Would the GC stay 30 seconds and book a demo?"

Current answer: Not yet. But closer.

Screenshots at /tmp/steve-pass9-5sec.png, /tmp/steve-pass9-checklist.png, /tmp/steve-pass9-final.png Test results at /tmp/steve-pass9-results.json
